title: User pastes DSN into the prompt before any tool runs
reason_not_testable: The DSN is in the user's prompt before any tool call. The spec's components only handle tool events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch), so secret_redact.py and secret_guard.py never receive user message text and cannot redact or deny it. Spec section 'Cases that genuinely cannot be tested' lists user-pasted prompts. Non-hook control: the user does not paste secrets (policy). Any prompt-side check would be a separate hook (UNVERIFIED design, not in the spec).
